            "capture_uid": self.cfg["capture_service_uid"],
            "socket_path": bound_receipt["socket"]["path"],
            "socket_device": bound_receipt["socket"]["dev"],
            "socket_inode": bound_receipt["socket"]["ino"],
            "socket_fd_device": socket_info.st_dev,
            "socket_fd_inode": socket_info.st_ino,
            "allowance": entry["scope"],
            "scope": {
                "Owner": entry["control_grant"]["owner"],
                "AttemptID": grant["attempt_id"],
                "RouteSHA256": route["route_sha256"],
                "TariffSHA256": route["usage_tariff_sha256"],
                "ExpiresAt": datetime.fromtimestamp(deadline / 1000, timezone.utc)
                .isoformat(timespec="milliseconds")
                .replace("+00:00", "Z"),
                "MaxOutputTokens": token_cap,
            },
        }
        raw = gateway_bootstrap_bytes(config, template_raw)
        require(1 <= len(raw) <= 262144, "root_gateway_bootstrap_size")
        fd = os.memfd_create(
            "sfactory-gateway-bootstrap", os.MFD_CLOEXEC | os.MFD_ALLOW_SEALING
        )
        try:
            view = memoryview(raw)
            while view:
                count = os.write(fd, view)
                require(count > 0, "root_gateway_bootstrap_write")
                view = view[count:]
            seals = (
                fcntl.F_SEAL_SEAL
                | fcntl.F_SEAL_WRITE
                | fcntl.F_SEAL_SHRINK
                | fcntl.F_SEAL_GROW
            )
            fcntl.fcntl(fd, fcntl.F_ADD_SEALS, seals)
            require(
                fcntl.fcntl(fd, fcntl.F_GET_SEALS) == seals,
                "root_gateway_bootstrap_seal",
            )
            frozen = {
                "config_sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
                "launch_sha256": launch,
                "grant_sha256": sha(grant),
                "scope_sha256": scope,
                "review_sha256": route["review_sha256"],
                "deadline_ms": deadline,
                "socket_device": config["socket_device"],
                "socket_inode": config["socket_inode"],
            }
            store(case / "gateway-bootstrap.json", frozen)
            return fd, frozen
        except BaseException:
            os.close(fd)
            raise

    def _accept_gateway_ready(self, grant, process, reader, frozen):
        case = self._current(grant)
        prepared = _decode(protected(case / "gateway-prepared.json", 0o600))
        receipt = read_gateway_cold_ready(
            reader, min(frozen["deadline_ms"], prepared["deadline_ms"])
        )
        expected = {
            k: frozen[k]
            for k in (
                "config_sha256",
                "launch_sha256",
                "grant_sha256",
                "scope_sha256",
                "review_sha256",
                "socket_device",
                "socket_inode",
            )
        }
        expected.update(
            schema=1,
            state="cold-ready",
            pid=process.pid,
            start_ticks=prepared["child"]["ticks"],
            uid=self.cfg["gateway_uid"],
            paid_ready=False,
        )
        require(
            type(receipt) is dict
            and receipt == expected
            and all(type(receipt[k]) is type(v) for k, v in expected.items()),
            "root_gateway_cold_ready_changed",
        )
        with self.gate.admission(), self.guard:
            with gateway_bind_lock(case):
                require(
                    _decode(protected(case / "gateway-bootstrap.json", 0o600))
                    == frozen,
                    "root_gateway_bootstrap_changed",
                )
            self._current(grant)
            require(
                self._saved_scope(grant) == frozen["scope_sha256"],
                "root_gateway_scope_changed",
            )
            check_guard(self, grant)
            self._verify_gateway_launch(
                case, grant, process.pid, receipt["start_ticks"], frozen["scope_sha256"]
            )
            inspect_gateway_peer(
                grant,
                process.pid,
                receipt["start_ticks"],
                self.cfg["gateway_uid"],
                self.cfg["gateway_executable_sha256"],
            )
            named = os.stat(
                "/var/lib/sfactory-harness/gw/" + grant["attempt_id"][4:] + ".sock",
                follow_symlinks=False,
            )
            require(
                stat.S_ISSOCK(named.st_mode)
                and named.st_uid == self.cfg["gateway_uid"]
                and named.st_gid == grant["broker_uid"]
                and stat.S_IMODE(named.st_mode) == 0o660
                and named.st_nlink == 1
                and (named.st_dev, named.st_ino)
                == (frozen["socket_device"], frozen["socket_inode"]),
                "root_gateway_socket_changed",
            )
            store(case / "gateway-cold-ready.json", receipt)
            with gateway_bind_lock(case):
                closed = _decode(protected(case / "gateway-parent-closed.json", 0o600))
                require_no_socket_copy((closed["kernel_dev"], closed["kernel_ino"]))
                store(
                    case / "gateway-cleanup-custody.json",
                    self._gateway_cleanup_custody(case, grant),
                )

    def _prepare_gateway(
        self,
        grant,
        bound_socket,
        program_fd,
        *,
        bootstrap_config_fd=None,
        cold_ready_fd=None,
    ):
        """Start and attach a gated child; return its still-closed release gate.

        This private construction path grants no inference authority. The
        caller owns the returned process and gate and must fence/reconcile on
        failure. Socket handoff cleanup and production bootstrap remain gated.
        """
        require(self.cfg.get("schema") in (4, 5), "root_gateway_socket_unconfigured")
        process = None
        helper_fd = bootstrap_fd = gate_r = gate_w = ready_r = ready_w = None
        ns_r = ns_w = map_r = map_w = None
        transferred = False
        try:
            with self.gate.admission(), self.guard:
                case = self._saved(grant)
                with gateway_bind_lock(case):
                    case = self._current(grant)
                    scope = self._saved_scope(grant)
                    self._kernel_scope(grant, empty=False)
                    ready = check_guard(self, grant)
                    require(
                        ready["owner_pid"] == os.getpid()
                        and ready["owner_ticks"] == _ticks(os.getpid()),
                        "root_gateway_guard_owner_changed",
                    )
                    bound = _decode(protected(case / "gateway-bound.json", 0o600))
                    expected = {
                        "grant_sha256": sha(grant),
                        "scope_sha256": scope,
                        "gateway_uid": self.cfg["gateway_uid"],
                        "broker_gid": grant["broker_uid"],
                    }
                    require(
                        type(bound) is dict
                        and set(bound) == {"intent", "socket"}
                        and bound["intent"] == expected
                        and type(bound["socket"]) is dict
                        and set(bound["socket"]) == {"path", "dev", "ino"}
                        and bound["socket"]["path"]
                        == "/var/lib/sfactory-harness/gw/"
                        + grant["attempt_id"][4:]
                        + ".sock"
                        and _integer(bound["socket"]["dev"], 1)
                        and _integer(bound["socket"]["ino"], 1)
                        and type(program_fd) is int
                        and program_fd >= 3,
                        "root_gateway_bound_receipt_changed",
                    )
                    socket_info = os.fstat(bound_socket.fileno())
                    require(
                        stat.S_ISSOCK(socket_info.st_mode),
                        "root_gateway_socket_changed",
                    )
                    store(
                        case / "gateway-spawn-intent.json",
                        {"intent": expected, "socket": bound["socket"]},
                    )
                    helper_fd = stage_gateway_exec()
                    bootstrap_fd = stage_gateway_userns()
                    gate_r, gate_w = os.pipe()
                    ready_r, ready_w = os.pipe()
                    ns_r, ns_w = os.pipe()
                    map_r, map_w = os.pipe()
                    now = time.time_ns() // 1000000
                    deadline = min(grant["expires_at_ms"], now + 15000)
                    require(now < deadline, "root_gateway_deadline_expired")
                    config = {
                        "gateway_uid": self.cfg["gateway_uid"],
                        "gateway_gid": self.cfg["gateway_uid"],
                        "broker_gid": grant["broker_uid"],
                        "owner_pid": os.getpid(),
                        "owner_ticks": _ticks(os.getpid()),
                        "boot_id": grant["boot_id"],
                        "cgroup_path": grant["cgroup_path"],
                        "cgroup_dev": grant["cgroup_dev"],
                        "cgroup_ino": grant["cgroup_ino"],
                        "socket_path": bound["socket"]["path"],
                        "socket_fd": bound_socket.fileno(),
                        "socket_dev": bound["socket"]["dev"],
                        "socket_ino": bound["socket"]["ino"],
                        "program_fd": program_fd,
                        "program_sha256": self.cfg["gateway_executable_sha256"],
                        "gate_fd": gate_r,
                        "ready_fd": ready_w,
                        "deadline_ms": deadline,
                    }
                    extra_fds = ()
                    bootstrap_extra = {}
                    if self.cfg.get("schema") == 5:
                        require(
                            type(bootstrap_config_fd) is int
                            and type(cold_ready_fd) is int,
                            "root_gateway_bootstrap_unconfigured",
                        )
                        config.update(
                            bootstrap_fd=bootstrap_config_fd,
                            cold_ready_fd=cold_ready_fd,
                        )
                        extra_fds = (bootstrap_config_fd, cold_ready_fd)
                        bootstrap_extra = self._gateway_namespace_roles()
                    process = subprocess.Popen(
                        [
                            self.cfg["python"],
                            "-I",
                            "-B",
                            f"/proc/self/fd/{bootstrap_fd}",
                            canonical(
                                {
                                    **bootstrap_extra,
                                    "uid": self.cfg["gateway_uid"],
                                    "broker_gid": grant["broker_uid"],
                                    "owner_pid": config["owner_pid"],
                                    "owner_ticks": config["owner_ticks"],
                                    "ready_fd": ns_w,
                                    "map_fd": map_r,
                                    "helper_fd": helper_fd,
                                    "helper_config": config,
                                    "python": self.cfg["python"],
                                    "deadline_ms": deadline,
                                }
                            ),
                        ],
                        stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                        stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                        stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                        pass_fds=(
                            helper_fd,
                            bootstrap_fd,
                            program_fd,
                            bound_socket.fileno(),
                            gate_r,
                            ready_w,
                            ns_w,
                            map_r,
                            *extra_fds,
                        ),
                        cwd="/",
                        env={},
                        start_new_session=True,
                    )
            # The parent must not retain a socket copy after handing it to the child.
            bound_socket.close()
            require_no_socket_copy((socket_info.st_dev, socket_info.st_ino))
            with self.gate.admission(), self.guard:
                with gateway_bind_lock(case):
                    self._current(grant)
                    self._kernel_scope(grant, empty=False)
                    ready = check_guard(self, grant)
                    require(
                        ready["owner_pid"] == os.getpid()
                        and ready["owner_ticks"] == _ticks(os.getpid()),
                        "root_gateway_guard_owner_changed",
                    )
                    store(
                        case / "gateway-parent-closed.json",
                        {
                            "intent": expected,
                            "socket": bound["socket"],
                            "child_pid": process.pid,
                            "child_ticks": _ticks(process.pid),
                            "kernel_dev": socket_info.st_dev,
                            "kernel_ino": socket_info.st_ino,
                        },
                    )
            os.close(gate_r)
            gate_r = None
            os.close(ready_w)
            ready_w = None
            os.close(ns_w)
            ns_w = None
            os.close(map_r)
            map_r = None
            wait = min(5.0, max(0.0, (deadline - time.time_ns() // 1000000) / 1000))
            require(
                wait > 0
                and select.select([ns_r], [], [], wait)[0]
                and os.read(ns_r, 1) == b"N",
                "root_gateway_namespace_not_ready",
            )
            with self.gate.admission(), self.guard:
                with gateway_bind_lock(case):
                    self._current(grant)
                    self._kernel_scope(grant, empty=False)
                    guard = check_guard(self, grant)
                    require(
                        guard["owner_pid"] == os.getpid()
                        and guard["owner_ticks"] == _ticks(os.getpid())
                        and time.time_ns() // 1000000 < deadline,
                        "root_gateway_guard_owner_changed",
                    )
                    child_ticks = _ticks(process.pid)
                    namespace = map_gateway_user_namespace(
                        process,
                        child_ticks,
                        self.cfg["gateway_uid"],
                        grant["broker_uid"],
                        **self._gateway_namespace_roles(),
                    )
                    namespace_receipt = {
                        "grant_sha256": sha(grant),
                        "scope_sha256": scope,
                        "pid": process.pid,
                        "ticks": child_ticks,
                        "namespace": namespace,
                    }
                    store(case / "gateway-userns.json", namespace_receipt)
                    self._current(grant)
                    self._kernel_scope(grant, empty=False)
                    guard = check_guard(self, grant)
                    require(
                        guard["owner_pid"] == os.getpid()
                        and guard["owner_ticks"] == _ticks(os.getpid())
                        and time.time_ns() // 1000000 < deadline,
                        "root_gateway_guard_owner_changed",
                    )
                    require(
                        os.write(map_w, b"M") == 1, "root_gateway_map_release_unknown"
                    )
            os.close(map_w)
            map_w = None
            wait = min(5.0, max(0.0, (deadline - time.time_ns() // 1000000) / 1000))
            require(
                wait > 0
                and select.select([ready_r], [], [], wait)[0]
                and os.read(ready_r, 1) == b"R",
                "root_gateway_barrier_not_ready",
            )
            inspect_gateway_user_namespace(
                process,
                child_ticks,
                self.cfg["gateway_uid"],
                grant["broker_uid"],
                namespace,
                **self._gateway_namespace_roles(),
            )
            attached = self._attach_gateway(grant, process)
            require(attached["ticks"] == child_ticks, "root_gateway_userns_changed")
            gate_info = os.fstat(gate_w)
            require(
                stat.S_ISFIFO(gate_info.st_mode) and not os.get_inheritable(gate_w),
                "root_gateway_gate_changed",
            )
            store(
                case / "gateway-prepared.json",
                {
                    "grant_sha256": sha(grant),
                    "child": attached,
                    "gate_dev": gate_info.st_dev,
                    "gate_ino": gate_info.st_ino,
                    "deadline_ms": deadline,
                    "namespace": namespace_receipt,
                },
            )
            transferred = True
            return process, gate_w, attached
        finally:
            bound_socket.close()
            for fd in (
                helper_fd,
                bootstrap_fd,
                gate_r,
                ready_r,
                ready_w,
                ns_r,
                ns_w,
                map_r,
                map_w,
            ):
                if fd is not None:
                    os.close(fd)
            if not transferred:
                if gate_w is not None:
                    os.close(gate_w)
                if process is not None:
                    if process.poll() is None:
                        process.kill()
                    process.wait(timeout=5)

    def _attach_gateway(self, grant, process):
        """Attach a gated child under current authority; never release its gate.

        The caller owns the child and must close its gate and fence the attempt
        on any failure or unknown result.
        """
        require(self.cfg.get("schema") in (4, 5), "root_gateway_socket_unconfigured")
        with self.gate.admission(), self.guard:
            case = self._saved(grant)
            with gateway_bind_lock(case):
                case = self._current(grant)
                scope = self._saved_scope(grant)
                self._kernel_scope(grant, empty=False)
                ready = check_guard(self, grant)
                require(
                    ready["owner_pid"] == os.getpid()
                    and ready["owner_ticks"] == _ticks(os.getpid()),
                    "root_gateway_guard_owner_changed",
                )
                socket_intent = {
                    "grant_sha256": sha(grant),
                    "scope_sha256": scope,
                    "gateway_uid": self.cfg["gateway_uid"],
                    "broker_gid": grant["broker_uid"],
                }
                bound = _decode(protected(case / "gateway-bound.json", 0o600))
                created_socket = _decode(
                    protected(case / "gateway-created.json", 0o600)
                )
                parent_closed = _decode(
                    protected(case / "gateway-parent-closed.json", 0o600)
                )
                require(
                    type(bound) is dict
                    and set(bound) == {"intent", "socket"}
                    and bound == created_socket
                    and bound["intent"] == socket_intent
                    and type(bound["socket"]) is dict
                    and set(bound["socket"]) == {"path", "dev", "ino"}
                    and bound["socket"]["path"]
                    == "/var/lib/sfactory-harness/gw/"
                    + grant["attempt_id"][4:]
                    + ".sock"
                    and _integer(bound["socket"]["dev"], 1)
                    and _integer(bound["socket"]["ino"], 1)
                    and type(parent_closed) is dict
                    and set(parent_closed)
                    == {
                        "intent",
                        "socket",
                        "child_pid",
                        "child_ticks",
                        "kernel_dev",
                        "kernel_ino",
                    }
                    and parent_closed["intent"] == socket_intent
                    and parent_closed["socket"] == bound["socket"]
                    and parent_closed["child_pid"] == process.pid
                    and _integer(parent_closed["child_ticks"], 1)
                    and _integer(parent_closed["kernel_dev"], 0, 2**64 - 1)
                    and _integer(parent_closed["kernel_ino"], 1, 2**64 - 1),
                    "root_gateway_bound_receipt_changed",
                )
                intent = {
                    "grant_sha256": sha(grant),
                    "scope_sha256": scope,
                    "gateway_uid": self.cfg["gateway_uid"],
                }
                store(case / "gateway-leaf-intent.json", intent)
                created = None

                def record_leaf(identity):
                    nonlocal created
                    require(
                        created is None
                        and type(identity) is dict
                        and set(identity) == {"path", "dev", "ino"}
                        and identity["path"] == grant["cgroup_path"] + "/gateway"
                        and _integer(identity["dev"], 1)
                        and _integer(identity["ino"], 1),
                        "root_gateway_leaf_identity_changed",
                    )
                    store(
                        case / "gateway-leaf-created.json",
                        {"intent": intent, "leaf": identity},
                    )
                    created = copy.deepcopy(identity)

                attached = attach_gateway_child(
                    grant, process, self.cfg["gateway_uid"], on_created=record_leaf
                )
                require(
                    created is not None
                    and type(attached) is dict
                    and set(attached) == {"path", "dev", "ino", "pid", "ticks"}
                    and {k: attached[k] for k in ("path", "dev", "ino")} == created
                    and attached["pid"] == process.pid
                    and attached["ticks"] == parent_closed["child_ticks"]
                    and _integer(attached["ticks"], 1),
                    "root_gateway_attach_unknown",
                )
                self._current(grant)
                self._kernel_scope(grant, empty=False)
                ready = check_guard(self, grant)
                require(
                    ready["owner_pid"] == os.getpid()
                    and ready["owner_ticks"] == _ticks(os.getpid()),
                    "root_gateway_guard_owner_changed",
                )
                store(
                    case / "gateway-attached.json",
                    {"intent": intent, "child": attached},
                )
                return attached

    def _release_gateway(self, grant, process, gate_fd):
        """Consume one prepared gate after rechecking Root and guard authority.

        The caller owns the Popen object without concurrent waits. This private
        method consumes gate_fd on every path; unknown results require fencing
        and reconciliation, never another release or inference retry.
        """
        try:
            require(
                self.cfg.get("schema") in (4, 5), "root_gateway_socket_unconfigured"
            )
            with self.gate.admission(), self.guard:
                case = self._saved(grant)
                with gateway_bind_lock(case):
                    case = self._current(grant)
                    scope = self._saved_scope(grant)
                    self._kernel_scope(grant, empty=False)
                    ready = check_guard(self, grant)
                    require(
                        ready["owner_pid"] == os.getpid()
                        and ready["owner_ticks"] == _ticks(os.getpid()),
                        "root_gateway_guard_owner_changed",
                    )
                    prepared = _decode(protected(case / "gateway-prepared.json", 0o600))
                    attached = _decode(protected(case / "gateway-attached.json", 0o600))
                    userns = _decode(protected(case / "gateway-userns.json", 0o600))
                    intent = {
                        "grant_sha256": sha(grant),
                        "scope_sha256": scope,
                        "gateway_uid": self.cfg["gateway_uid"],
                    }
                    require(
                        type(prepared) is dict
                        and set(prepared)
                        == {
                            "grant_sha256",
                            "child",
                            "gate_dev",
                            "gate_ino",
                            "deadline_ms",
                            "namespace",
                        }
                        and prepared["grant_sha256"] == sha(grant)
                        and type(userns) is dict
                        and set(userns)
                        == {"grant_sha256", "scope_sha256", "pid", "ticks", "namespace"}
                        and userns == prepared["namespace"]
                        and userns["grant_sha256"] == sha(grant)
                        and userns["scope_sha256"] == scope
                        and userns["pid"] == process.pid
                        and type(userns["namespace"]) is dict
                        and set(userns["namespace"]) == {"dev", "ino"}
                        and type(attached) is dict
                        and set(attached) == {"intent", "child"}
                        and attached["intent"] == intent
                        and attached["child"] == prepared["child"]
                        and type(prepared["child"]) is dict
                        and prepared["child"].get("pid") == process.pid
                        and prepared["child"].get("ticks") == userns["ticks"]
                        and _integer(prepared["deadline_ms"], 1)
                        and prepared["deadline_ms"] <= grant["expires_at_ms"]
                        and time.time_ns() // 1000000 < prepared["deadline_ms"]
                        and _integer(prepared["gate_dev"], 0, 2**64 - 1)
                        and _integer(prepared["gate_ino"], 1, 2**64 - 1)
                        and _integer(gate_fd, 3, 1048575),
                        "root_gateway_prepared_receipt_changed",
                    )
                    info = os.fstat(gate_fd)
                    require(
                        stat.S_ISFIFO(info.st_mode)
                        and (info.st_dev, info.st_ino)
                        == (prepared["gate_dev"], prepared["gate_ino"])
                        and fcntl.fcntl(gate_fd, fcntl.F_GETFL) & os.O_ACCMODE
                        == os.O_WRONLY
                        and not os.get_inheritable(gate_fd),
                        "root_gateway_gate_changed",
                    )
                    inspect_prepared_gateway(
                        grant, prepared["child"], self.cfg["gateway_uid"]
                    )
                    inspect_gateway_user_namespace(
                        process,
                        userns["ticks"],
                        self.cfg["gateway_uid"],
                        grant["broker_uid"],
                        userns["namespace"],
                        **self._gateway_namespace_roles(),
                    )
                    release = {
                        "grant_sha256": sha(grant),
                        "prepared_sha256": sha(prepared),
                    }
                    store(case / "gateway-release-intent.json", release)
                    self._current(grant)
                    self._kernel_scope(grant, empty=False)
                    ready = check_guard(self, grant)
                    require(
                        ready["owner_pid"] == os.getpid()
                        and ready["owner_ticks"] == _ticks(os.getpid())
                        and time.time_ns() // 1000000 < prepared["deadline_ms"],
                        "root_gateway_guard_owner_changed",
                    )
                    inspect_prepared_gateway(
                        grant, prepared["child"], self.cfg["gateway_uid"]
                    )
                    inspect_gateway_user_namespace(
                        process,
                        userns["ticks"],
                        self.cfg["gateway_uid"],
                        grant["broker_uid"],
                        userns["namespace"],
                        **self._gateway_namespace_roles(),
                    )
                    info = os.fstat(gate_fd)
                    require(
                        stat.S_ISFIFO(info.st_mode)
                        and (info.st_dev, info.st_ino)
                        == (prepared["gate_dev"], prepared["gate_ino"])
                        and fcntl.fcntl(gate_fd, fcntl.F_GETFL) & os.O_ACCMODE
                        == os.O_WRONLY
                        and not os.get_inheritable(gate_fd),
                        "root_gateway_gate_changed",
                    )
                    require(
                        os.write(gate_fd, b"G") == 1, "root_gateway_release_unknown"
                    )
                    store(case / "gateway-released.json", release)
                    return release
        finally:
            if type(gate_fd) is int and gate_fd >= 0:
                os.close(gate_fd)

    def _verify_gateway_launch(self, case, grant, pid, ticks, scope):
        """Check the released direct child; caller holds current authority/guard.

        This is a point-in-time launch/namespace check, not an egress fence.
        Non-reaping child inspection preserves the launcher's Popen ownership.
        """
        with gateway_bind_lock(case):
            try:
                prepared = _decode(protected(case / "gateway-prepared.json", 0o600))
                attached = _decode(protected(case / "gateway-attached.json", 0o600))
                userns = _decode(protected(case / "gateway-userns.json", 0o600))
                released = _decode(protected(case / "gateway-released.json", 0o600))
                intent = _decode(protected(case / "gateway-release-intent.json", 0o600))
            except (OSError, ValueError, ControlRefused):
                raise SupervisorRefused("root_gateway_launch_unqualified") from None
            grant_sha256 = sha(grant)
            expected = {
                "grant_sha256": grant_sha256,
                "scope_sha256": scope,
                "gateway_uid": self.cfg["gateway_uid"],
            }
            require(
                type(prepared) is dict
                and set(prepared)
                == {
                    "grant_sha256",
                    "child",
                    "gate_dev",
                    "gate_ino",
                    "deadline_ms",
                    "namespace",
                }
                and prepared["grant_sha256"] == grant_sha256
                and type(attached) is dict
                and set(attached) == {"intent", "child"}
                and attached["intent"] == expected
                and attached["child"] == prepared["child"]
                and type(prepared["child"]) is dict
                and prepared["child"].get("pid") == pid
                and prepared["child"].get("ticks") == ticks
                and type(userns) is dict
                and set(userns)
                == {"grant_sha256", "scope_sha256", "pid", "ticks", "namespace"}
                and prepared["namespace"] == userns
                and userns["grant_sha256"] == grant_sha256
                and userns["scope_sha256"] == scope
                and userns["pid"] == pid
                and userns["ticks"] == ticks
                and intent
                == released
                == {"grant_sha256": grant_sha256, "prepared_sha256": sha(prepared)},
                "root_gateway_launch_changed",
            )
            inspect_prepared_gateway(grant, prepared["child"], self.cfg["gateway_uid"])
            inspect_gateway_user_namespace(
                SimpleNamespace(pid=pid),
                ticks,
                self.cfg["gateway_uid"],
                grant["broker_uid"],
                userns["namespace"],
                **self._gateway_namespace_roles(),
            )

    def gateway_peer_v1(self, body):
        """Recheck an authenticated broker's kernel-reported gateway peer."""
        require(
            type(body) is dict
            and set(body) == {"attempt", "scope_sha256", "pid", "start_ticks"}
            and type(body["attempt"]) is dict
            and _digest(body["scope_sha256"])
            and _integer(body["pid"], 2, 2**31 - 1)
            and _integer(body["start_ticks"], 1, 2**63 - 1),
            "root_gateway_peer_invalid",
        )
        require(self.cfg.get("schema") in (4, 5), "root_gateway_peer_unconfigured")
        self.scope_preimage_v2(
            {"attempt": body["attempt"], "scope_sha256": body["scope_sha256"]}
        )
        with self.gate.admission(), self.guard:
            case = self._case(body["attempt"]["attempt_id"])
            grant = _decode(protected(case / "grant.json", 0o600))
            self._current(grant)
            require(
                self._saved_scope(grant) == body["scope_sha256"],
                "root_gateway_peer_changed",
            )
            self._kernel_scope(grant, empty=False)
            ready = check_guard(self, grant)
            require(
                ready["owner_pid"] == os.getpid()
                and ready["owner_ticks"] == _ticks(os.getpid()),
                "root_gateway_guard_owner_changed",
            )
            if self.cfg.get("schema") == 5:
                cold = _decode(protected(case / "gateway-cold-ready.json", 0o600))
                frozen = _decode(protected(case / "gateway-bootstrap.json", 0o600))
                require(
                    cold.get("pid") == body["pid"]
                    and cold.get("start_ticks") == body["start_ticks"]
                    and cold.get("grant_sha256") == sha(grant)
                    and cold.get("scope_sha256") == body["scope_sha256"]
                    and cold.get("config_sha256") == frozen.get("config_sha256")
                    and cold.get("paid_ready") is False,
                    "root_gateway_cold_ready_changed",
                )
            self._verify_gateway_launch(
                case, grant, body["pid"], body["start_ticks"], body["scope_sha256"]
            )
            inspect_gateway_peer(
                grant,
                body["pid"],
                body["start_ticks"],
                self.cfg["gateway_uid"],
                self.cfg["gateway_executable_sha256"],
            )
            self._current(grant)
            self._kernel_scope(grant, empty=False)
            return {
                "verified": True,
                "pid": body["pid"],
                "start_ticks": body["start_ticks"],
                "scope_sha256": body["scope_sha256"],
            }

    def close(self, body):
        require(set(body) == {"attempt", "scope_sha256"}, "root_close_changed")
        attempt = body["attempt"]
        case = self._case(attempt["attempt_id"])
        intent = _decode(protected(case / "prepare-intent.json", 0o600))
        require(intent["attempt"] == attempt, "root_close_attempt_changed")
        grant = _decode(protected(case / "grant.json", 0o600))
        require(
            self._saved_scope(grant) == body["scope_sha256"], "root_close_scope_changed"
        )
        self.revoke({"grant": grant})
        return {"scope_sha256": body["scope_sha256"], "status": "closed"}

    def prepare(self, body):
        require(
            set(body) == {"attempt", "admission", "recipe"}
            and body["recipe"] == self.recipe,
            "root_prepare_changed",
        )
        attempt, admission = body["attempt"], body["admission"]
        with self.gate.admission(), self.guard:
            entry, lease = self._catalog(attempt, admission)
            case = self._case(attempt["attempt_id"])
            require(
                not os.path.lexists(case)
                and not os.path.lexists(self.runtime / attempt["attempt_id"]),
                "root_prepare_already_attempted",
            )
            os.mkdir(case, 0o700)
            store(case / "prepare-intent.json", body)
            # The actual owner repeats its existing registry gates and durable scope admission.
            require(
                self.owner.admit(entry["scope"]) == entry["scope_sha256"],
                "root_owner_admission_unknown",
            )
            group = entry["cgroup"]
            now = time.time_ns() // 1000000
            grant = dict(
                schema=1,
                attempt_id=attempt["attempt_id"],
                attempt_sha256=sha(attempt),
                admission_sha256=sha(admission),
                recipe_sha256=sha(self.recipe),
                grant_id=secrets.token_hex(32),
                issued_at_ms=now,
                expires_at_ms=min(
                    now + self.recipe["max_runtime_ms"], lease["expires_at_ms"]
                ),
                worker_uid=self.recipe["worker_uid"],
                broker_uid=self.recipe["broker_uid"],
                boot_id=group["boot_id"],
                cgroup_dev=group["dev"],
                cgroup_ino=group["ino"],
                cgroup_path=group["path"],
                workspace_path=str(self.runtime / attempt["attempt_id"] / "work"),
                relay_path=str(self.runtime / attempt["attempt_id"] / "relay.sock"),
            )
            validate_grant(
                grant, attempt, admission, self.recipe, self.runtime, now_ms=now
            )
            self._kernel_scope(grant, empty=True)
            runtime = self.runtime / attempt["attempt_id"]
            os.mkdir(runtime, 0o700)
            os.chown(runtime, grant["broker_uid"], grant["broker_uid"])
            os.mkdir(runtime / "work", 0o700)
            os.chown(runtime / "work", grant["broker_uid"], grant["broker_uid"])
            store(
                case / "owner-scope.json",
                {"grant_sha256": sha(grant), "scope_sha256": entry["scope_sha256"]},
            )
            store(case / "grant.json", grant)
            return grant

    def _current(self, grant):
        case = self._saved(grant)
        intent = _decode(protected(case / "prepare-intent.json", 0o600))
        self._catalog(intent["attempt"], intent["admission"])
        require(
            time.time_ns() // 1000000 < grant["expires_at_ms"]
            and not os.path.lexists(case / "stop.json")
            and not os.path.lexists(case / "execution-fenced.json")
            and not os.path.lexists(case / "cleanup.json"),
            "root_launch_expired_or_revoked",
        )
        return case

    def _worker(self, grant, item):
        pid = item["State"]["Pid"]
        require(
            item["State"]["Running"] is True and _integer(pid, 1),
            "root_worker_unavailable",
        )
        base = Path("/proc") / str(pid)
        fields = dict(
            line.split(":", 1)
            for line in (base / "status").read_text().splitlines()
            if ":" in line
        )
        uid = [int(x) for x in fields["Uid"].split()]
        require(uid == [grant["worker_uid"]] * 4, "root_worker_identity_changed")
        ticks = _ticks(pid)
        member = (base / "cgroup").read_text().strip().splitlines()
        path = grant["cgroup_path"].removeprefix("/sys/fs/cgroup")
        require(
            len(member) == 1
            and member[0].startswith("0::")
            and (member[0][3:] == path or member[0][3:].startswith(path + "/")),
            "root_worker_cgroup_changed",
        )
        net = os.stat(base / "ns/net")
        own = os.stat("/proc/self/ns/net")
        result = dict(
            schema=1,
            grant_sha256=sha(grant),
            pid=pid,
            start_ticks=ticks,
            worker_uid=uid[0],
            no_new_privs=int(fields["NoNewPrivs"]),
            seccomp=int(fields["Seccomp"]),
            network_dev=net.st_dev,
            network_ino=net.st_ino,
            boot_id=grant["boot_id"],
            cgroup_dev=grant["cgroup_dev"],
            cgroup_ino=grant["cgroup_ino"],
        )
        return validate_worker(result, grant, host_network=(own.st_dev, own.st_ino))

    def _require_current_gateway(self, grant, process=None):
        try:
            case = self._current(grant)
            receipt = _decode(protected(case / "gateway-cold-ready.json", 0o600))
            frozen = _decode(protected(case / "gateway-bootstrap.json", 0o600))
            if process is None:
                process = self.gateway_children.get(grant["attempt_id"])
            require(
                process is not None
                and process.pid == receipt["pid"]
                and process.poll() is None
                and _integer(frozen.get("deadline_ms"), time.time_ns() // 1000000 + 1),
                "root_gateway_lifetime_changed",
            )
            self._verify_gateway_launch(
                case,
                grant,
                receipt["pid"],
                receipt["start_ticks"],
                self._saved_scope(grant),
            )
            inspect_gateway_peer(
                grant,
                receipt["pid"],
                receipt["start_ticks"],
                self.cfg["gateway_uid"],
                self.cfg["gateway_executable_sha256"],
            )
        except Exception:
            self.revoke({"grant": grant})
            raise

    def start(self, body):
        require(
            set(body) == {"grant", "prompt", "declarations_sha256", "worker_protocol"}
            and body["worker_protocol"] == "unix-json-v1"
            and isinstance(body["prompt"], str)
            and 0 < len(body["prompt"].encode()) <= 65536
            and _digest(body["declarations_sha256"]),
            "root_start_changed",
        )
        grant = body["grant"]
        with self.gate.admission(), self.guard:
            case = self._current(grant)
            require(
                not os.path.lexists(case / "start-intent.json"),
                "root_start_already_attempted",
            )
            intent = _decode(protected(case / "prepare-intent.json", 0o600))
            # Protected catalog publisher freezes exact generic prompt/declarations per attempt.
            contract = _decode(
                protected(self.catalog / (grant["attempt_id"] + ".launch.json"), 0o600)
            )
            require(
                set(contract)
                == {
                    "prompt_sha256",
                    "declarations_sha256",
                    "profile_sha256",
                    "max_output_tokens",
                }
                and contract["prompt_sha256"]
                == hashlib.sha256(body["prompt"].encode()).hexdigest()
                and contract["declarations_sha256"] == body["declarations_sha256"]
                and contract["profile_sha256"] == intent["attempt"]["profile"]
                and _integer(contract["max_output_tokens"], 1, 16384),
                "root_prompt_or_tools_changed",
            )
            store(case / "start-intent.json", body)
            profile = dict(
                schema=1,
                purpose=self.recipe["purpose"],
                worker_uid=grant["worker_uid"],
                broker_uid=grant["broker_uid"],
                goose_sha256=self.recipe["goose_sha256"],
                prompt_sha256=contract["prompt_sha256"],
                declarations_sha256=contract["declarations_sha256"],
                max_output_tokens=contract["max_output_tokens"],
                max_runtime_ms=self.recipe["max_runtime_ms"],
            )
            store(case / "profile.json", canonical(profile).encode(), 0o444)
            store(case / "prompt.txt", body["prompt"].encode(), 0o444)
            entry, _ = self._catalog(intent["attempt"], intent["admission"])
            goose_profile = dict(
                schema=1,
                profile="nuc-root-supervised-stdio-v1",
                task_id=entry["factory_task_id"],
                generation=entry["scope"]["generation"],
                recipe_sha256=sha(self.recipe),
                worker_uid=grant["worker_uid"],
            )
            store(case / "goose-profile.json", canonical(goose_profile).encode(), 0o444)
            start_guard(self, grant)
            gateway = None
            if self.cfg.get("schema") == 5:
                program = os.open(
                    self.cfg["gateway_program"],
                    os.O_RDONLY | os.O_CLOEXEC | os.O_NOFOLLOW,
                )
                try:
                    gateway, _ = self._launch_gateway(grant, program)
                finally:
                    os.close(program)
            mounts = case / "mounts"
            os.mkdir(mounts, 0o700)
            expected = dict(
                goose=self.recipe["goose_sha256"],
                worker=self.cfg["worker_program_sha256"],
                profile=hashlib.sha256(canonical(profile).encode()).hexdigest(),
                goose_profile=hashlib.sha256(
                    canonical(goose_profile).encode()
                ).hexdigest(),
                prompt=contract["prompt_sha256"],
            )
            descriptors = []
            try:
                paths = {}
                for name, path in (
                    ("goose", self.cfg["goose"]),
                    ("worker", self.cfg["worker_program"]),
                    ("profile", case / "profile.json"),
                    ("goose_profile", case / "goose-profile.json"),
                    ("prompt", case / "prompt.txt"),
                    ("relay", grant["relay_path"]),
                ):
                    fd = os.open(path, os.O_PATH | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
                    descriptors.append(fd)
                    info = os.fstat(fd)
                    require(
                        (
                            name == "relay"
                            and stat.S_ISSOCK(info.st_mode)
                            and info.st_uid == grant["broker_uid"]
                            and info.st_gid == grant["worker_uid"]
                            and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == 0o660
                        )
                        or (
                            name != "relay"
                            and stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode)
                            and info.st_uid == 0
                            and info.st_mode & 0o022 == 0
                        ),
                        "root_launch_source_changed",
                    )
                    paths[name] = stage_launch_source(
                        fd, path, mounts / name, expected.get(name)
                    )
                require(
                    self._docker("info", "--format", "{{.CgroupDriver}}")
                    .decode()
                    .strip()
                    == "systemd",
                    "root_cgroup_driver_unqualified",
                )
                image = json.loads(self._docker("image", "inspect", WORKER_IMAGE))[0]
                require(not image["Config"].get("Volumes"), "root_image_volume_changed")
                check_guard(self, grant)
                if self.cfg.get("schema") == 5:
                    self._require_current_gateway(grant, gateway)
                identity = (
                    self._docker(*docker_arguments(grant, **paths)).decode().strip()
                )
                require(_digest(identity), "root_create_unknown")
                store(case / "container.json", dict(id=identity))
                self._inspect(grant)
                self._current(grant)
                check_guard(self, grant)
                if self.cfg.get("schema") == 5:
                    self._require_current_gateway(grant, gateway)
                self._docker("start", identity)
                observed = self._worker(grant, self._inspect(grant))
                store(case / "worker.json", observed)
                return observed
            finally:
                for fd in descriptors:
                    os.close(fd)

    def _fence_execution(self, grant):
        # The daemon may be unavailable or holding a queued start. Keep the exact
        # dedicated parent frozen, including future arrivals, before querying it.
        self._saved(grant)
        require(
            Path("/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id").read_text().strip()
            == grant["boot_id"],
            "root_fence_boot_changed",
        )
        fd = os.open(grant["cgroup_path"], os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
        try:
            info = os.fstat(fd)
            require(
                (info.st_dev, info.st_ino) == (grant["cgroup_dev"], grant["cgroup_ino"])
                and info.st_uid == 0
                and info.st_mode & 0o022 == 0,
                "root_fence_cgroup_changed",
            )
            for name in ("cgroup.freeze", "cgroup.kill"):
                control = os.open(name, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=fd)
                try:
                    require(os.write(control, b"1") == 1, "root_fence_unverified")
                finally:
                    os.close(control)
            deadline = time.monotonic() + 1
            while True:
                values = {}
                for name in ("cgroup.freeze", "cgroup.events"):
                    control = os.open(name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=fd)
                    try:
                        values[name] = os.read(control, 4097)
                    finally:
                        os.close(control)
                require(
                    all(len(v) <= 4096 for v in values.values()),
                    "root_fence_unverified",
                )
                if (
                    values["cgroup.freeze"].strip() == b"1"
                    and b"populated 0" in values["cgroup.events"].splitlines()
                ):
                    break
                require(time.monotonic() < deadline, "root_fence_unverified")
                time.sleep(0.01)
        finally:
            os.close(fd)
        case = self._saved(grant)
        receipt = {"grant_sha256": sha(grant), "state": "execution_fenced"}
        if not os.path.lexists(case / "execution-fenced.json"):
            try:
                store(case / "execution-fenced.json", receipt)
            except FileExistsError:
                pass
        require(
            _decode(protected(case / "execution-fenced.json", 0o600)) == receipt,
            "root_fence_receipt_changed",
        )

    def _gateway_cleanup_custody(self, case, grant):
        names = (
            "start-intent",
            "gateway-bind-intent",
            "gateway-created",
            "gateway-bound",
            "gateway-spawn-intent",
            "gateway-parent-closed",
            "gateway-userns",
            "gateway-leaf-intent",
            "gateway-leaf-created",
            "gateway-attached",
            "gateway-prepared",
            "gateway-bootstrap",
            "gateway-release-intent",
            "gateway-released",
            "gateway-cold-ready",
            "guard-intent",
        )
        records = {
            name: _decode(protected(case / (name + ".json"), 0o600)) for name in names
        }
        closed = records["gateway-parent-closed"]
        prepared = records["gateway-prepared"]
        return {
            "schema": 1,
            "grant_sha256": sha(grant),
            "scope_sha256": self._saved_scope(grant),
            "configuration_sha256": sha(self.cfg),
            "exec_sha256": GATEWAY_EXEC_SHA256,
            "userns_sha256": GATEWAY_USERNS_SHA256,
            "records": {name: sha(value) for name, value in records.items()},
            "namespace": prepared["namespace"]["namespace"],
            "child": prepared["child"],
            "socket": records["gateway-bound"]["socket"],
            "parent_pid": records["guard-intent"]["owner_pid"],
            "parent_ticks": records["guard-intent"]["owner_ticks"],
            "kernel_dev": closed["kernel_dev"],
            "kernel_ino": closed["kernel_ino"],
        }

    def _cleanup(self, grant):
        case = self._saved(grant)
        self._fence_execution(grant)
        process = getattr(self, "gateway_children", {}).get(grant["attempt_id"])
        if process is not None:
            try:
                process.wait(timeout=5)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                raise SupervisorRefused("root_gateway_join_unknown") from None
        if self.cfg.get("schema") in (4, 5):
            with gateway_bind_lock(case):
                if os.path.lexists(case / "gateway-bound.json"):
                    require(
                        self.cfg.get("schema") == 5, "root_gateway_cleanup_unqualified"
                    )
                    try:
                        custody = _decode(
                            protected(case / "gateway-cleanup-custody.json", 0o600)
                        )
                    except FileNotFoundError:
                        raise SupervisorRefused(
                            "root_gateway_cleanup_unqualified"
                        ) from None
                    require(
                        custody == self._gateway_cleanup_custody(case, grant),
                        "root_gateway_cleanup_custody_changed",
                    )
                    require_gateway_custody_absent(custody)
                    return self._cleanup_after_fence(grant, case, custody=custody)
                intent_path = case / "gateway-bind-intent.json"
                created_path = case / "gateway-created.json"
                require(
                    not os.path.lexists(created_path) or os.path.lexists(intent_path),
                    "root_gateway_bind_intent_changed",
                )
                if os.path.lexists(intent_path):
                    intent = _decode(protected(intent_path, 0o600))
                    expected = {
                        "grant_sha256": sha(grant),
                        "scope_sha256": self._saved_scope(grant),
                        "gateway_uid": self.cfg["gateway_uid"],
                        "broker_gid": grant["broker_uid"],
                    }
                    require(intent == expected, "root_gateway_bind_intent_changed")
                    if os.path.lexists(created_path):
                        created = _decode(protected(created_path, 0o600))
                        require(
                            type(created) is dict
                            and set(created) == {"intent", "socket"}
                            and created["intent"] == intent,
                            "root_gateway_created_receipt_changed",
                        )
                        remove_gateway_socket(grant["attempt_id"], created["socket"])
                    else:
                        require(
                            gateway_socket_absent(grant["attempt_id"]),
                            "root_gateway_cleanup_unqualified",
                        )
                    receipt = {
                        "grant_sha256": sha(grant),
                        "state": "absent_before_handoff",
                    }
                    path = case / "gateway-absent.json"
                    if not os.path.lexists(path):
                        try:
                            store(path, receipt)
                        except FileExistsError:
                            pass
                    require(
                        _decode(protected(path, 0o600)) == receipt,
                        "root_gateway_absence_receipt_changed",
                    )
                leaf_intent_path = case / "gateway-leaf-intent.json"
                leaf_created_path = case / "gateway-leaf-created.json"
                require(
                    not os.path.lexists(leaf_created_path)
                    or os.path.lexists(leaf_intent_path),
                    "root_gateway_leaf_intent_changed",
                )
                if os.path.lexists(leaf_intent_path):
                    leaf_intent = _decode(protected(leaf_intent_path, 0o600))
                    require(
                        leaf_intent
                        == {
                            "grant_sha256": sha(grant),
                            "scope_sha256": self._saved_scope(grant),
                            "gateway_uid": self.cfg["gateway_uid"],
                        },
                        "root_gateway_leaf_intent_changed",
                    )
                    if os.path.lexists(leaf_created_path):
                        created = _decode(protected(leaf_created_path, 0o600))
                        require(
                            type(created) is dict
                            and set(created) == {"intent", "leaf"}
                            and created["intent"] == leaf_intent,
                            "root_gateway_leaf_receipt_changed",
                        )
                        remove_fenced_gateway_leaf(grant, created["leaf"])
                    else:
                        require(
                            gateway_leaf_absent(grant),
                            "root_gateway_leaf_cleanup_unqualified",
                        )
                return self._cleanup_after_fence(grant, case)
        return self._cleanup_after_fence(grant, case)

    def _cleanup_after_fence(self, grant, case, *, custody=None):
        name = "sfactory-harness-" + grant["attempt_id"][4:]
        # A successful daemon query distinguishes absence from an unavailable daemon.
        identities = (
            self._docker(
                "container",
                "ls",
                "--all",
                "--no-trunc",
                "--filter",
                "name=^/" + name + "$",
                "--format",
                "{{.ID}}",
            )
            .decode()
            .splitlines()
        )
        require(len(identities) <= 1, "root_cleanup_identity_changed")
        if identities:
            item = self._inspect(grant)
            require(item["Id"] == identities[0], "root_cleanup_identity_changed")
            self._docker("rm", "-f", item["Id"])
        elif os.path.lexists(case / "start-intent.json"):
            # An unacknowledged create can still be pending in the daemon. Do not
            # turn an empty listing into a successful cleanup receipt in that case.
            require(
                os.path.lexists(case / "container.json"),
                "root_create_requires_reconciliation",
            )
        self._kernel_scope(grant, empty=True)
        if custody is not None:
            require_gateway_custody_absent(custody)
            child = custody["child"]
            remove_fenced_gateway_leaf(
                grant, {k: child[k] for k in ("path", "dev", "ino")}
            )
            remove_gateway_socket(
                grant["attempt_id"],
                custody["socket"],
                absent_ok=os.path.lexists(case / "cleanup.json"),
            )
            require(
                gateway_socket_absent(grant["attempt_id"]),
                "root_gateway_cleanup_unknown",
            )
        receipt = {"grant_sha256": sha(grant), "state": "absent"}
        if not os.path.lexists(case / "cleanup.json"):
            try:
                store(case / "cleanup.json", receipt)
            except FileExistsError:
                pass
        require(
            _decode(protected(case / "cleanup.json", 0o600)) == receipt,
            "root_cleanup_receipt_changed",
        )
        mounts = case / "mounts"
        if mounts.exists():
            for name in MOUNT_TARGETS:
                path = mounts / name
                path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            try:
                mounts.rmdir()
            except FileNotFoundError:
                pass

    def observe(self, body):
        require(set(body) == {"grant", "worker"}, "root_observe_changed")
        grant = body["grant"]
        case = self._saved(grant)
        require(
            _decode(protected(case / "worker.json", 0o600)) == body["worker"],
            "root_worker_changed",
        )
        if os.path.lexists(case / "finished.json"):
            self._revoke_spending(grant)
            return _decode(protected(case / "finished.json", 0o600))
        with self.guard:
            if os.path.lexists(case / "stop.json") and os.path.lexists(
                case / "cleanup.json"
            ):
                self._kernel_scope(grant, empty=True)
                self._revoke_spending(grant)
                result = dict(
                    grant_sha256=sha(grant),
                    state="finished",
                    worker=body["worker"],
                    exit_code=137,
                    timed_out=time.time_ns() // 1000000 >= grant["expires_at_ms"],
                    overflow=False,
                )
                store(case / "finished.json", result)
                return result
            item = self._inspect(grant)
            try:
                self._current(grant)
            except Exception:
                self.revoke({"grant": grant})
                result = dict(
                    grant_sha256=sha(grant),
                    state="finished",
                    worker=body["worker"],
                    exit_code=137,
                    timed_out=time.time_ns() // 1000000 >= grant["expires_at_ms"],
                    overflow=False,
                )
            else:
                if item["State"]["Running"]:
                    if self.cfg.get("schema") == 5:
                        self._require_current_gateway(grant)
                    require(
                        self._worker(grant, item) == body["worker"],
                        "root_worker_changed",
                    )
                    return dict(grant_sha256=sha(grant), state="running")
                result = dict(
                    grant_sha256=sha(grant),
                    state="finished",
                    worker=body["worker"],
                    exit_code=item["State"]["ExitCode"],
                    timed_out=item["State"]["ExitCode"] == 124,
                    overflow=item["State"]["ExitCode"] == 125,
                )
                self._cleanup(grant)
            self._revoke_spending(grant)
            store(case / "finished.json", result)
            return result

    def revoke(self, body):
        require(set(body) == {"grant"}, "root_revoke_changed")
        grant = body["grant"]
        case = self._saved(grant)
        if not os.path.lexists(case / "stop.json"):
            try:
                store(case / "stop.json", dict(grant_sha256=sha(grant)))
            except FileExistsError:
                pass
        try:
            self._cleanup(grant)
        finally:
            # Wallet or registry outage must never prevent the execution fence;
            # a daemon outage must never skip spending revocation either.
            self._revoke_spending(grant)
        return {"grant_sha256": sha(grant), "state": "stopped"}

    def _saved_scope(self, grant):
        case = self._saved(grant)
        value = _decode(protected(case / "owner-scope.json", 0o600))
        require(
            type(value) is dict
            and set(value) == {"grant_sha256", "scope_sha256"}
            and value["grant_sha256"] == sha(grant)
            and _digest(value["scope_sha256"]),
            "root_saved_scope_changed",
        )
        return value["scope_sha256"]

    def _revoke_spending(self, grant):
        scope = self._saved_scope(grant)
        case = self._saved(grant)
        receipt = {
            "grant_sha256": sha(grant),
            "scope_sha256": scope,
            "state": "revoked",
        }
        path = case / "owner-revoked.json"
        if not os.path.lexists(path):
            # Cleanup-only observers connect lazily, after the kernel fence.
            owner = getattr(self, "owner", None)
            if owner is None:
                owner = RootOwnerClient(
                    self.cfg["owner_socket"], self.cfg["owner_service_uid"]
                )
            require(owner.revoke(scope) is None, "root_owner_revocation_unknown")
            try:
                store(path, receipt)
            except FileExistsError:
                pass
        require(
            _decode(protected(path, 0o600)) == receipt,
            "root_owner_revocation_receipt_changed",
        )

    def reconcile(self, body):
        require(
            set(body) == {"attempt", "record", "recipe_sha256"}
            and body["recipe_sha256"] == sha(self.recipe),
            "root_reconcile_changed",
        )
        attempt = body["attempt"]
        case = self._case(attempt["attempt_id"])
        state = "unknown"
        if case.is_dir() and not any(
            os.path.lexists(case / name)
            for name in (
                "start-intent.json",
                "gateway-bind-intent.json",
                "gateway-spawn-intent.json",
                "gateway-release-intent.json",
            )
        ):
            intent = _decode(protected(case / "prepare-intent.json", 0o600))
            if intent["attempt"] == attempt:
                state = "not_started"
        value = dict(
            attempt_id=attempt["attempt_id"], attempt_sha256=sha(attempt), state=state
        )
        return value | {"receipt_sha256": sha(value)}


def _ticks(pid):
    return int(
        (Path("/proc") / str(pid) / "stat").read_text().rsplit(") ", 1)[1].split()[19]
    )


def _owner_alive(pid, ticks):
    try:
        fields = (
            (Path("/proc") / str(pid) / "stat").read_text().rsplit(") ", 1)[1].split()
        )
        return fields[0] not in ("Z", "X") and int(fields[19]) == ticks
    except (OSError, ValueError, IndexError):
        return False


def watchdog(configuration, identity, owner_pid, owner_ticks):
    supervisor = RootSupervisor(configuration, cleanup_only=True)
    case = supervisor._case(identity)
    grant = _decode(protected(case / "grant.json", 0o600))
    failed_at = None
    while not os.path.lexists(case / "finished.json"):
        if failed_at is None:
            try:
                require(_owner_alive(owner_pid, owner_ticks), "root_owner_lost")
                supervisor._current(grant)
            except Exception:
                failed_at = time.monotonic()
        if failed_at is not None:
            try:
                supervisor.revoke({"grant": grant})
                return
            except Exception:
                # Cleanup retries cannot acquire another launch or inference root.
                # Persistent frozen/unknown state survives this bounded observer.
                if time.monotonic() - failed_at >= 30:
                    return
        time.sleep(0.05)


class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self, *_):
        pass

    def setup(self):
        super().setup()
        self.connection.settimeout(5)

    def do_POST(self):
        try:
            import struct

            peer_pid, uid, _ = struct.unpack(
                "3i",
                self.connection.getsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_PEERCRED, 12),
            )
            require(
                uid == self.server.backend.recipe["broker_uid"], "root_caller_denied"
            )
            method = self.path.removeprefix("/harness-launch/")
            require(
                self.path == "/harness-launch/" + method
                and method
                in (
                    "admit",
                    "scope_preimage_v2",
                    "gateway_peer_v1",
                    "authorize_tool",
                    "close",
                    "prepare",
                    "start",
                    "observe",
                    "revoke",
                    "reconcile",
                ),
                "root_method_denied",
            )
            if method == "gateway_peer_v1":
                require_broker_pid_namespace(peer_pid)
            lengths = self.headers.get_all("Content-Length", [])
            require(
                len(lengths) == 1
                and lengths[0].isascii()
                and lengths[0].isdecimal()
                and 0 < int(lengths[0]) <= 131072
                and self.headers.get("Transfer-Encoding") is None
                and self.headers.get("Content-Encoding") in (None, "identity"),
                "root_frame_changed",
            )
            raw = self.rfile.read(int(lengths[0]))
            require(len(raw) == int(lengths[0]), "root_frame_changed")
            value = getattr(self.server.backend, method)(_decode(raw))
            reply = canonical(value).encode()
            require(len(reply) <= 32768, "root_reply_overflow")
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(reply)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(reply)
        except Exception:
            self.send_error(503, "protected launch unavailable")


class Server(socketserver.ThreadingUnixStreamServer):
    daemon_threads = True

    def __init__(self, backend):
        self.backend = backend
        self.slots = threading.BoundedSemaphore(8)
        super().__init__(backend.cfg["socket_path"], Handler)
        os.chown(backend.cfg["socket_path"], 0, backend.recipe["broker_uid"])
        os.chmod(backend.cfg["socket_path"], 0o660)

    def process_request(self, request, address):
        if not self.slots.acquire(False):
            self.shutdown_request(request)
            return
        try:
            super().process_request(request, address)
        except BaseException:
            self.slots.release()
            raise

    def process_request_thread(self, request, address):
        try:
            super().process_request_thread(request, address)
        finally:
            self.slots.release()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) == 6 and sys.argv[1] == "watchdog":
        watchdog(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3], int(sys.argv[4]), int(sys.argv[5]))
    elif len(sys.argv) == 3 and sys.argv[1] == "serve":
        with Server(RootSupervisor(sys.argv[2])) as server:
            server.serve_forever()
    else:
        raise SystemExit("expected serve CONFIG or fixed watchdog arguments")

import os,ctypes,subprocess,sys,json
root=sys.argv[1]
assert os.uname().machine=='x86_64'
assert os.stat('/proc/self/ns/mnt').st_ino != os.stat('/proc/1/ns/mnt').st_ino
subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/mount','--make-rprivate','/'],check=True)
python_identity=os.stat(root+'/usr/bin/python3.13')
base_identity=os.stat(root+sys.argv[3]);gw_identity=os.stat(root+'/var/lib/sfactory-harness/gw')
subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/mount','--rbind',root,root],check=True)
subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/mount','-t','proc','proc',root+'/proc'],check=True)
pid=os.fork()
if pid==0:
 os.chroot(root);os.chdir('/')
 libc=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True);rc=libc.unshare(0x10000000)
 error=ctypes.get_errno();print(json.dumps({'chroot_userns_result':rc,'errno':error}),flush=True);os._exit(0 if rc==-1 and error==1 else 1)
_,status=os.waitpid(pid,0);assert status==0
os.mkdir(root+'/.old-root',0o755)
libc=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
assert libc.syscall(155,root.encode(),(root+'/.old-root').encode())==0,ctypes.get_errno()
os.chdir('/')
assert libc.umount2(b'/.old-root',2)==0,ctypes.get_errno()
os.rmdir('/.old-root')
current_python=os.stat('/usr/bin/python3.13');assert (current_python.st_dev,current_python.st_ino)==(python_identity.st_dev,python_identity.st_ino)
for path,expected in [(sys.argv[3],base_identity),('/var/lib/sfactory-harness/gw',gw_identity)]:
 actual=os.stat(path);assert (actual.st_dev,actual.st_ino)==(expected.st_dev,expected.st_ino)
assert int(open('/proc/self/stat').read().split(' ',1)[0])==os.getpid()
assert not os.path.exists('/.old-root') and not os.path.exists('/assets')
pid=os.fork()
if pid==0:
 rc=libc.unshare(0x10000000);print(json.dumps({'pivot_userns_result':rc,'errno':ctypes.get_errno()}),flush=True);os._exit(0 if rc==0 else 1)
_,status=os.waitpid(pid,0);assert status==0
os.environ.clear();os.environ['DBUS_SYSTEM_BUS_ADDRESS']='unix:path=/run/systemd/private'
# Probe-only mode exits before authority, services or gateway side effects.
if len(sys.argv)>2 and sys.argv[2]=='probe-only':os._exit(0)
os.execve('/usr/bin/python3.13',['/usr/bin/python3.13','-I','-B',sys.argv[2],*sys.argv[3:]],os.environ)

import os,ctypes,subprocess,sys,json
root=sys.argv[1]
assert os.uname().machine=='x86_64'
assert os.stat('/proc/self/ns/mnt').st_ino != os.stat('/proc/1/ns/mnt').st_ino
subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/mount','--make-rprivate','/'],check=True)
python_identity=os.stat(root+'/usr/bin/python3.13')
base_identity=os.stat(root+sys.argv[3]);gw_identity=os.stat(root+'/var/lib/sfactory-harness/gw')
subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/mount','--rbind',root,root],check=True)
subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/mount','-t','proc','proc',root+'/proc'],check=True)
pid=os.fork()
if pid==0:
 os.chroot(root);os.chdir('/')
 libc=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True);rc=libc.unshare(0x10000000)
 error=ctypes.get_errno();print(json.dumps({'chroot_userns_result':rc,'errno':error}),flush=True);os._exit(0 if rc==-1 and error==1 else 1)
_,status=os.waitpid(pid,0);assert status==0
os.mkdir(root+'/.old-root',0o755)
libc=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
assert libc.syscall(155,root.encode(),(root+'/.old-root').encode())==0,ctypes.get_errno()
os.chdir('/')
assert libc.umount2(b'/.old-root',2)==0,ctypes.get_errno()
os.rmdir('/.old-root')
current_python=os.stat('/usr/bin/python3.13');assert (current_python.st_dev,current_python.st_ino)==(python_identity.st_dev,python_identity.st_ino)
for path,expected in [(sys.argv[3],base_identity),('/var/lib/sfactory-harness/gw',gw_identity)]:
 actual=os.stat(path);assert (actual.st_dev,actual.st_ino)==(expected.st_dev,expected.st_ino)
assert int(open('/proc/self/stat').read().split(' ',1)[0])==os.getpid()
assert not os.path.exists('/.old-root') and not os.path.exists('/assets')
pid=os.fork()
if pid==0:
 rc=libc.unshare(0x10000000);print(json.dumps({'pivot_userns_result':rc,'errno':ctypes.get_errno()}),flush=True);os._exit(0 if rc==0 else 1)
_,status=os.waitpid(pid,0);assert status==0
os.environ.clear();os.environ['DBUS_SYSTEM_BUS_ADDRESS']='unix:path=/run/systemd/private'
# Probe-only mode exits before authority, services or gateway side effects.
if len(sys.argv)>2 and sys.argv[2]=='probe-only':os._exit(0)
os.execve('/usr/bin/python3.13',['/usr/bin/python3.13','-I','-B',sys.argv[2],*sys.argv[3:]],os.environ)

import os,ctypes,subprocess,sys,json
root=sys.argv[1]
assert os.uname().machine=='x86_64'
assert os.stat('/proc/self/ns/mnt').st_ino != os.stat('/proc/1/ns/mnt').st_ino
subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/mount','--make-rprivate','/'],check=True)
python_identity=os.stat(root+'/usr/bin/python3.13')
base_identity=os.stat(root+sys.argv[3]);gw_identity=os.stat(root+'/var/lib/sfactory-harness/gw')
subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/mount','--rbind',root,root],check=True)
subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/mount','-t','proc','proc',root+'/proc'],check=True)
pid=os.fork()
if pid==0:
 os.chroot(root);os.chdir('/')
 libc=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True);rc=libc.unshare(0x10000000)
 error=ctypes.get_errno();print(json.dumps({'chroot_userns_result':rc,'errno':error}),flush=True);os._exit(0 if rc==-1 and error==1 else 1)
_,status=os.waitpid(pid,0);assert status==0
os.mkdir(root+'/.old-root',0o755)
libc=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
assert libc.syscall(155,root.encode(),(root+'/.old-root').encode())==0,ctypes.get_errno()
os.chdir('/')
assert libc.umount2(b'/.old-root',2)==0,ctypes.get_errno()
os.rmdir('/.old-root')
current_python=os.stat('/usr/bin/python3.13');assert (current_python.st_dev,current_python.st_ino)==(python_identity.st_dev,python_identity.st_ino)
for path,expected in [(sys.argv[3],base_identity),('/var/lib/sfactory-harness/gw',gw_identity)]:
 actual=os.stat(path);assert (actual.st_dev,actual.st_ino)==(expected.st_dev,expected.st_ino)
assert int(open('/proc/self/stat').read().split(' ',1)[0])==os.getpid()
assert not os.path.exists('/.old-root') and not os.path.exists('/assets')
pid=os.fork()
if pid==0:
 rc=libc.unshare(0x10000000);print(json.dumps({'pivot_userns_result':rc,'errno':ctypes.get_errno()}),flush=True);os._exit(0 if rc==0 else 1)
_,status=os.waitpid(pid,0);assert status==0
os.environ.clear();os.environ['DBUS_SYSTEM_BUS_ADDRESS']='unix:path=/run/systemd/private'
# Probe-only mode exits before authority, services or gateway side effects.
if len(sys.argv)>2 and sys.argv[2]=='probe-only':os._exit(0)
os.execve('/usr/bin/python3.13',['/usr/bin/python3.13','-I','-B',sys.argv[2],*sys.argv[3:]],os.environ)

import os,ctypes,subprocess,sys,json
root=sys.argv[1]
assert os.uname().machine=='x86_64'
assert os.stat('/proc/self/ns/mnt').st_ino != os.stat('/proc/1/ns/mnt').st_ino
subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/mount','--make-rprivate','/'],check=True)
python_identity=os.stat(root+'/usr/bin/python3.13')
base_identity=os.stat(root+sys.argv[3]);gw_identity=os.stat(root+'/var/lib/sfactory-harness/gw')
subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/mount','--rbind',root,root],check=True)
subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/mount','-t','proc','proc',root+'/proc'],check=True)
pid=os.fork()
if pid==0:
 os.chroot(root);os.chdir('/')
 libc=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True);rc=libc.unshare(0x10000000)
 error=ctypes.get_errno();print(json.dumps({'chroot_userns_result':rc,'errno':error}),flush=True);os._exit(0 if rc==-1 and error==1 else 1)
_,status=os.waitpid(pid,0);assert status==0
os.mkdir(root+'/.old-root',0o755)
libc=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
assert libc.syscall(155,root.encode(),(root+'/.old-root').encode())==0,ctypes.get_errno()
os.chdir('/')
assert libc.umount2(b'/.old-root',2)==0,ctypes.get_errno()
os.rmdir('/.old-root')
current_python=os.stat('/usr/bin/python3.13');assert (current_python.st_dev,current_python.st_ino)==(python_identity.st_dev,python_identity.st_ino)
for path,expected in [(sys.argv[3],base_identity),('/var/lib/sfactory-harness/gw',gw_identity)]:
 actual=os.stat(path);assert (actual.st_dev,actual.st_ino)==(expected.st_dev,expected.st_ino)
assert int(open('/proc/self/stat').read().split(' ',1)[0])==os.getpid()
assert not os.path.exists('/.old-root') and not os.path.exists('/assets')
pid=os.fork()
if pid==0:
 rc=libc.unshare(0x10000000);print(json.dumps({'pivot_userns_result':rc,'errno':ctypes.get_errno()}),flush=True);os._exit(0 if rc==0 else 1)
_,status=os.waitpid(pid,0);assert status==0
os.environ.clear();os.environ['DBUS_SYSTEM_BUS_ADDRESS']='unix:path=/run/systemd/private'
# Probe-only mode exits before authority, services or gateway side effects.
if len(sys.argv)>2 and sys.argv[2]=='probe-only':os._exit(0)
os.execve('/usr/bin/python3.13',['/usr/bin/python3.13','-I','-B',sys.argv[2],*sys.argv[3:]],os.environ)
